sentences.en: The sinews in his arms are exceptionally strong.
sentences.zh: 他胳膊里的肌腱特别强壮。

sentences.en: Her performance relies on the sinew and flexibility of her body.
sentences.zh: 她的表演依赖于身体的肌腱和灵活性。

sentences.en: The old warrior's sinews have lost some of their strength over time.
sentences.zh: 这位老战士的肌腱随着年龄增长失去了部分力量。
